sourceFile: 18. TIU C11-20  Report test VP finf reason NG funtion 2026.1.15_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft cites real rows but incorrectly merges several distinct VP function test comparisons into one changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor over-groups temperature, lot date, line, AWF, shift, and A2/D3 movement tests.
Baseline Normal rows are section-specific and should not be pooled across unrelated comparisons.
Model/side keys such as C11-20L and C11-20R are treated as changed conditions instead of subgroup context.
Header-derived measurement outcome is not a valid measurement result and duplicates defect-category counts.
Some cited evidence rows are not shown in context, limiting interpretation of missing intermediate rows.
correctionPlan: Split cases by report sections or Type contexts: temperature/force, lot date 6/1, same-lot A2-D3, AWF, and A2-to-D3 movement.
Assign the matching Normal baseline within each section only.
Preserve model, side, date, shift, lot, machine, and process route as subgroup keys where applicable.
Keep functional NG metrics as outcomes with input, OK, total NG, NG rate, and defect categories.
Remove the generated measurement-stat outcome unless true measurement data exists.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient for final evidence until regrouped with section-level context.
